row.scim_plan: Unknown (B2 Enterprise Web Console, Private Preview)
row.evidence: Backblaze documents SCIM (Base URL plus API token, Okta 'SCIM 2.0 Test App' or a non-gallery Entra app) only for the B2 Cloud Storage Enterprise Web Console, which its docs say 'is currently in Private Preview'; the Computer Backup pricing page lists Enterprise Control with OIDC SSO but no SCIM.
row.notes: Status changed from 'gated' to 'unknown'. June said Computer Backup's Enterprise Control add-on (+$24/computer/yr) included SCIM; no first-party page now ties SCIM to Enterprise Control (its help article and the pricing page list OIDC SSO, lockdowns and restore controls only), and Enterprise Control is now 'Let's talk / Contact us' rather than a listed price, so the $24 figure is dropped. The June pricing URL (backblaze.com/business/backup/pricing) now returns 404; Computer Backup pricing moved to /cloud-backup/pricing. Business Backup is $99 per computer per year, so per-user fields stay null. The only documented SCIM is for the B2 Cloud Storage Enterprise Web Console (Org Users > Identity Provider), marked Private Preview with no public plan or price. 'SSO via Google and Microsoft' on all business accounts is social-style sign-in and does not count as SSO.

plans.name: Business Backup
plans.notes: Google/Microsoft sign-in only (not counted as SSO).

plans.name: B2 Cloud Storage Enterprise Web Console

scim.notes: Version 2.0 inferred from Backblaze's instruction to use Okta's 'SCIM 2.0 Test App (Header Auth)'. Scope: B2 Cloud Storage Enterprise Web Console only.

auth.token_source: Backblaze organization > Access Control > Org Users > Identity Provider > Import Users > Generate Key (Base URL + API Key)

roles.how: Provisioned users get no roles; roles are assigned in the console to the user or to user groups

limitations.text: Enterprise Web Console (where SCIM lives) is in Private Preview.
Groups are not provisioned: Entra group provisioning is switched off and Okta group assignments surface only as individual users.

okta.notes: The OIN 'Backblaze' app has only SWA checked (read from page markup). Backblaze's SCIM guide uses Okta's generic 'SCIM 2.0 Test App (Header Auth)' instead, hence idp.okta = via_generic.

fallbacks.other_sync: Computer Backup groups can auto-admit members from allowed email domains via an invitation link
